query.note: Each layer queried separately; combined-layer responses were rejected as malformed. Returned pixel coordinates are preserved; nominal grid spacing is not a point survey accuracy.

interpretation.deck: 2022 AMB25cm LiDAR surface samples follow the center walking route. Roof-occluded summit replaced by65.65m plateau extrapolated from adjacent stair flights; the shelter roof is separately modeled. Large1m2024 DSM variations near edges/roofs are not fitted as stair elevations.
interpretation.terrain: National50cm LiDAR terrain samples establish approximately41.9m river bed/water area and56.833m west approach. DTM follows the bridge approach embankments at the ends but excludes elevated spans.
interpretation.roofs: 2022 LiDAR samples around summit near70.5–71.3m and gateway66.6m constrain top envelopes;2024 photogrammetric spikes are treated cautiously.
interpretation.lateral: Summit cross-section shows the structure offset about1m north of the OSM route: north-3m still intersects roof, south+2m is river. Model applies-1m nativeZ bias; exact wall edges require full raster/orthophoto review.
interpretation.uncertainty: This is sampled remote sensing, not as-built survey. Thin rails, arch intrados, vertical faces and2026 repairs are not resolved.
